content.short: Business banking, POS and payments for African SMEs.
content.description: Moniepoint is one of Africa's largest business banking and payments platforms, serving millions of small and medium businesses primarily in Nigeria. It provides business bank accounts, a vast network of POS terminals and agents, payment acceptance, working-capital loans, and expense and inventory tools that help merchants and entrepreneurs run and grow their operations. Moniepoint has expanded from powering agency banking and card payments into full personal and business banking, and through MonieWorld it is building cross-border services for the diaspora. By combining reliable payment infrastructure with accounts and credit at massive scale, Moniepoint has become a backbone of everyday commerce for African SMEs, processing large volumes of transactions across the continent.
content.meta: Moniepoint powers business banking, POS, and payments for millions of African SMEs. Discover Moniepoint and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
